# Fixture — towns (F2 landed)

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/design/content/towns.md` after PR #133: the harbour-master is
`Gaelrek`, and the rename note bolds the two attested threshold names it was one letter from —
the shape the real document has at `towns.md:96-98`.

## 3. Naming

| Name | Derivation | Reads as |
|---|---|---|
| Vaenern | *vaen* (iron) + *–ern* (agent, non-priestly) | "the iron-worker" |
| Korrern | *korr* (passage) + *–ern* (agent) | "the passage-keeper" |
| Gaelrek | *gael* (water, flow) + *rek* (administer, keep in place) | "keeper of the water" |

## 4.1 Crestfall

| `slug` (archetype) | placement id | name | role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `village-blacksmith` | `crestfall-smith` | Vaenern | smith, market stall |
| `harbour-master` | `tolvaren-harbour-master` | Gaelrek | harbour-master |

## 5. The rename

**Renamed 2026-11-20 — `Gaelraeth` → `Gaelrek`.** The harbour-master's byname stood as *gael* +
*raeth*, which put it one letter from **Kael-Raeth** ("compact's threshold") and from **Vaelraeth**,
the Wound's first zone. The replacement keeps the water root and takes *rek* (administer, keep in
place) — the root *Dornrek* and *Velrek* already use.
